research_rationale:
EO 11659 (Establishment of the Upper Mississippi River Basin Commission), signed 1972-03-22. The order establishes the Upper Mississippi River Basin Commission (Section 1), fixes its jurisdiction (Section 2) and membership (Section 3), functions (Section 4), consultation with adjoining States (Section 5) and reporting (Section 6). Its held text has no sunset or termination provision. EO 11737 (1973) rewrote Sections 2 and 5, changed the State list in Section 3(3) and inserted a new international-coordination section, redesignating Section 6 as Section 7. First end: Section 5(b) of EO 12319 (River Basin Commissions, signed 1981-09-09 and published at 46 FR 45591) names Executive Order No. 11659, as amended, among the orders revoked effective January 1, 1982, so the revocation took effect on 1982-01-01. The Federal Register issue text also carries a 3 CFR index entry for this order recording the revocation by EO 12319 with the same effective date (the text layer is OCR with broken letter spacing, so I describe it without quotation). Section 1 of EO 12319 lists the commission established by this order as terminated on December 31, 1981, but it names commissions and not their establishing orders; under the owner ruling on unnamed instruments that is a disclosed earlier candidate and not an end.  Machine searches adopted after reading their coverage notes: the U.S. Code search (release point 119-121, 7 hits for this order), the eCFR search as of 2026-10-14 (7 hits) and the Federal Register executive-order catalog disposition-note search (6 hits). They are leads only; the end, the later events and the savings were decided from the held Federal Register texts named in this claim. Search of the held order texts for this order's number (the packet records a bounded number-citation search over its lookup corpus, excluding clause-draft copies): apart from the order's own copies, the matching files are EO 11737, EO 11882, EO 12038, EO 12148, EO 12319.
